node: Healthcare education capacity: ABSN, OTA, nursing simulation, VR, lab infrastructure, and clinical-placement enablement
summary: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe for the healthcare-education-capacity node. The clearest reference exposure is Grand Canyon Education, whose investor materials explicitly mention ABSN/OTA university partners plus simulation technology and virtual reality investment. The underfollowed lane is stronger in smaller software and infrastructure enablers: HealthStream for clinical rotations, workforce training, credentialing, and simulation-management software; CAE for healthcare simulation equipment and training technology; and Adtalem as a more direct healthcare-education operator with Chamberlain nursing and medical/veterinary schools. This is a research universe only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
